details.effect: [fanfare] Give this follower [attack]+X/[defense]+X. X equals the number of Forest Bat tokens on your field. [act][cost01], put a Forest Bat token from your field into its owner's cemetery: Select an enemy follower on the field. Deal 3 damage to it and 1 damage to its leader.

issues: The activated ability cost is wrong: it should require both paying 1 PP and putting a Forest Bat token from your field into its owner's cemetery, not banishing a Forest Bat from your EX area. Encode the extra cost using a field-bury cost/effect that selects your Forest Bat on the field.

The damage effect is encoded with the wrong operation and is missing the required selected enemy follower target. It should select an enemy follower, deal 3 damage to that follower, and 1 damage to its leader using op "damageFollowerAndLeader".
